title: Do not assign intact-rail stiffness to a weak written register
statement: In ROOT separate segmented surrogate EA=840kN/rail,p=.02m and serial register springk give EA_eff=1/(1/EA+1/(kp)),EI_eff=EA_eff*S. A1m20Ncantilever has rigid-register8.46561mm linear deflection,12.02116mm atk1e8 and9.17672mm atk5e8; the introduced10mmlimit needsk>=2.31724e8N/m under other fixed values. Base moment20Nm carries axial forces533.333,-266.667,-266.667N; much smaller one-pitch increments do not erase those loads. This is not an intact-ribbon law, nonlinear large-deflection result, curved-profile qualification or constructed release/lock transition.

requires: Three ideal planar rail centroids at section radius25mm, offsets y=(25,-12.5,-12.5)mm and S=sum y^2=.0009375m2; untwisted centerline, positive1-y_i*kappa. Material phase observation refers to actual cumulative registry at every frozen checkpoint, not motor commands. The deliberately segmented per-rail serial-spring stiffness surrogate is distinct from an uninterrupted homogeneous coiled tape; no transfer of their favorable properties or common fabricated architecture is assumed.

assumptions: The kinematic identity is planar, not full3D contact/material mechanics. Equal-pitch incompatibility applies only to undeformed identical rails in one-to-one registry, not all zippers. The feed-error history is a coherent discrete rest-length surrogate, not proof that real tape slip realizes it. The segmented spring model is not a constitutive law for intact ribbon with external clips; linear large-deflection rows/buckling screens are not nonlinear qualification. Source descriptions of load/fatigue are not unread-paper structural ratings. No supplied writer, real retained register, sensor or complete useful-system operation.

obstruction: Construct a common physical mechanism and its loaded state transitions, actual checkpoint registry observation, retained stiffness and stock recovery before composing these separate contracts. Alternative sliding, strain, pairing, direct shape measurement and flexible/articulated rails remain possible with their own paid mechanisms. No new construction, experiment, source recovery or standalone scientific replay is authorized by publication.
